title: finding(core): `chart-category-key.ts` docblock says `ObjectChart` forwards `schema.xAxisKey` verbatim as the render binding; since objectui#10634 a groupBy-only object-bound chart forwards the groupBy column
body:
Filing-gate category: ② published prose that no longer matches the code it describes (a docblock), with named sites. Minor: comment-only. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10673 at `9285295`. That PR is merged as `a95ec202` (card objectui#10634). The review called this "a one-line follow-up, not owed by this diff", and the seat's ACCEPT on objectui#10634 noted it. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` `f905090a1`)

- `packages/core/src/utils/chart-category-key.ts:51-54`, the "⚠️ NOT the same function as `resolveChartCategoryField`" section: "`plugin-charts`' own `resolveChartCategoryField` (objectui#8168) reads `aggregate.groupBy` first too — which is exactly why `ObjectChart` does NOT refuse this shape at its own level, and then forwards `schema.xAxisKey` verbatim as the render binding anyway."
- What `ObjectChart` does now: `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:1241-1244` computes `groupByCategoryKey = aggregateGroupByKey(schema.aggregate)` when the chart draws rows it fetched for an object and `normalizeChartSchema(schema, language).xAxisKey` answers nothing. `:1251` spreads it as `xAxisKey` into the non-dataset arm of `finalSchema`. So for a chart that names its category with `aggregate.groupBy` alone, the render binding is the groupBy result column, not `schema.xAxisKey`. The "verbatim" clause still holds when an axis is authored, or when the chart draws authored rows or a dataset.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Rewrite the one clause so it names the objectui#10634 fill, or points at `ObjectChart`'s `groupByCategoryKey` block instead of restating what is forwarded. The rest of the section (FIELD vs COLUMN) is unaffected and is the reason that block uses `aggregateGroupByKey`. Comment-only; a `@object-ui/core` patch changeset if the package's changeset gate asks for one.

## Dedupe

REST read of objectui issues and PRs (the 1000 most recent, plus every item updated since 2026-09-25T12:00Z; 1069 items), titles and bodies matched against `chart-category-key`: 0 hits. Lit control: the same walk matches objectui#10673 for `groupByCategoryKey|objectui#10634`.
